note: Draft register for Spec 056 (design D-17, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign plan approved by the owner AS WRITTEN on 2026-10-21 (campaign member 12; one of the three fragment recoveries, with D-15 and D-19). Conventions as in Specs 042/046: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-HELD-SOURCE (the held cleaned text is the source of record for Wells 2015; its hash governs over any other copy), ASM-PASSAGE-IS-SECTION (the passage of record is the headed section spec §2 fixes — a draft reading, DD-056-1, that the freeze confirms or re-bounds), ASM-CLAIM-FORM (a claim in this program's form states a proposition about an identified subject with a statable falsification condition), ASM-TWO-PASS (two independent extraction passes plus quotation-settled reconciliation are a trustworthy instrument for the argument-versus-catalogue judgement), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (integrity and pinning precede any extraction), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; prior and frozen records are never edited). FREEZE RECOVERY (2026-10-21): normalised to engine evidence values at 0.6-draft (kind observed, source_quality artifact; refs, descriptions, observed_at unchanged - the draft's free-form labels are not engine values); freeze rulings DD-056-10 to DD-056-17 were carried into the boundaries of F056-C05, C07, C08, C09, C11, and C12 before the hooks ran. At 0.7-draft the 14 irreducibility-challenged claim texts (all except F056-C03) were restated as single head propositions with carried clauses moved into boundaries verbatim-in-substance, and every multi-item claim's evidence gained mutual independent_of declarations. A final restatement of F056-C08's head cleared the last irreducibility and absolute-language records.

claims.text: Re-extraction is two independent passes over the pinned passage only.
claims.boundary: Neither pass may consult the claim record's adopted explanation, the design packet, this spec's §1, any other passage of the book, or any corpus or positional result while extracting. Freeze rulings: DD-056-14 confirms the two-pass mechanics - the passes are two independent executor runs, each seeing only the pinned passage and spec section 5, and unsettled disagreement resolves against recovery; DD-056-16 requires a worked dry-run of the section 4-5 sheet and checklist machinery on a passage other than the passage of record before the protocol touches the fragment. Carried from the draft text: each pass produces an extraction sheet of candidate propositions carried by verbatim quotes with locators, followed by a recorded reconciliation whose candidate set is the union of the sheets and whose unsettled disagreements resolve against recovery.

claims.text: A candidate proposition is a recovered claim only under the recovery test of spec §5.
claims.boundary: The conditions are conjunctive and are applied per candidate on the reconciled sheet, with the failing condition named for every candidate that fails. The design's illustrations (a spread that rules out a narrow meaning; a specific classification) illustrate R-2's form and bind nothing else. Freeze ruling: the conjunctive R-1 through R-5 recovery test is confirmed as drafted; a candidate failing any one condition is not recovered, with the failing condition named. Carried from the draft text: R-1 it is stated from the passage's own argument and is not the bare fragment restated; R-2 it is a specific contention a contrary finding could oppose; R-3 its subject is identified under F056-C09; R-4 a falsification condition is statable from the passage's own logic; R-5 the passage's stated numbers, contexts, and conditions are carried with it. Carried from the 0.7-draft head text: a candidate is a recovered claim if and only if it passes all five recovery conditions.
alternatives: recovering a specific but unfalsifiable assertion (refused: specificity without a falsification condition is the fragment's own defect, at greater length)
inventing a falsification condition the passage's logic does not supply (refused under R-4: that manufactures the claim the act exists to test for)
falsification_tests: the checklist per candidate is the test: the outcome record must show R-1…R-5 per reconciled candidate, and any outcome inconsistent with its own checklists falsifies the outcome record

alternatives: a mechanism or reading narrative attached to a recovery because the passage 'suggests' one beyond its stated proposition (refused: the recovered claim is the passage's proposition in form, nothing larger)
